candidates.reason: Directly imports and exercises scrapy.utils.misc.walk_modules_iter across package recursion, nested packages, leaf modules, missing modules, deprecation delegation, and egg-backed discovery. This is the primary regression surface named by the PR.
SpiderLoader uses walk_modules_iter for recursive spider-module discovery and exercises import failures, warning-only fallback, and duplicate-module handling through a production consumer.
CLI command discovery is implemented with walk_modules_iter and these tests verify built-in and project command modules are enumerated and executed correctly.
